issues: 背景三行黄 / 品红 / 紫 / 蓝四色彩虹描边字墙抢戏，和粉紫烟雾环、彩虹描边巨字不是一套色
卡片群重心偏左上，收束点、环心和巨字不在一条视线上
收束到点后有约 14f 只剩小环的黑场空档，高潮在这里断气
巨字是细描边霓虹，0.72→1 慢慢放大，读作淡入而不是爆点；收尾只有一个词，没有完整锁版
changes: look 换成 aurora：卡片辉光、字墙、烟雾环、巨字统一到紫 → 粉 → 奶桃一条色带；彩虹字墙换成两行 300px 单色淡紫描边「SHIP FASTER」反向缓移，卡后一团极光主光托起卡片群
构图收拢：卡片群、收束点、环心、巨字共用一个中心（画面中心下移 30px）；卡片 UI 换皮成虚构产品 Pulse，仍按 CARD_ZOOM 布局级放大保证清晰
补上能量断档：吸入到点同一帧中心一团白热闪核 + 全屏微曝（6f 衰减，只用径向光，不画描边环、不加粒子），烟雾环从闪核里长出
巨字改成实心白热芯 → 淡紫渐变 + 粉紫双层泛光，收束后 4f 就砸进来（14f snappy 1.22→1 + 字距收拢），之后极缓长大不停
环心里加「PULSE 3.0」眉题与 44px 标语错峰升起，尾帧是完整发布海报；用户历次裁决全部保留（三卡零模糊、单个湍流环、站定不停转、10f 快收束）
issuesEn: Three rows of yellow, magenta, violet and blue rainbow-outlined words fought for attention and didn't share a palette with the pink-violet smoke ring or the rainbow-outlined headline
The card cluster sat up and to the left, so the collapse point, ring centre and headline weren't on one line of sight
After the collapse there were about 14 frames of near-black with only a small ring: the climax ran out of breath right there
The headline was a thin neon outline that grew slowly from 0.72 to 1, reading as a fade-in rather than a hit; the end had a single word and no full lockup
changesEn: Aurora look: card glow, type wall, smoke ring and headline all sit on one violet → pink → peach band; the rainbow wall became two rows of 300px single-colour lavender outline 'SHIP FASTER' drifting in opposite directions, with an aurora key light lifting the cards

Tighter composition: cards, collapse point, ring centre and headline share one centre (30px below frame centre); the card UI is reskinned as a fictional product, Pulse, still rasterised at layout zoom for sharpness

The energy gap is filled: on the collapse frame a white-hot core flash plus a light full-frame lift decays over 6f (radial light only, no outline ring, no particles) and the smoke ring grows out of it

The headline is now solid, a white-hot core fading to lavender with a two-layer pink-violet glow; it slams in 4f after the collapse (14f snappy 1.22→1 with tracking tightening) and then keeps growing very slowly

A 'PULSE 3.0' kicker and a 44px tagline rise inside the ring for a full launch-poster end frame; every earlier user ruling is kept (no blur on the cards, one turbulent ring, continuous slow spin, a fast 10f collapse)
